crons.comment: Tier-1 watchlist and the government sitemap, daily before the working day.
Classify what arrived overnight. Runs after ingest so the queue is fresh.
Promote the shortlist into Sanity as drafts. Nothing is auto-published (spec 8.3).
Auto-unpublish anything past its expiry, so the board cannot fill with dead links.
Weekly HEAD check on crawl-based sources, which cannot use set-difference closure detection (spec 7.8).
Weekly employer/ATS discovery from the two EA boards. Poll them at most daily; weekly is plenty (spec 7.6).
